findings.title: Coverage counts rows outside the requested product shape
findings.description: `ledger_totals` is filtered by the requested shape, but `raw_counts` scans every `tick_trade` row in the session time range without filtering by unit or request shape. If the tick database contains rows from another product or request shape, those rows appear as raw-only instruments in `_session_row` and cause false mismatches. Restrict the raw count to the units represented by the requested shape, or otherwise filter it to the same instrument set as the ledger.

findings.title: Caught-up can be reported without a computable wanted range
findings.description: When an entry has a tier and start date but neither a configured end nor a dataset edge, `wanted` is `None`, so the status scope contains only held sessions. The `caught_up` call nevertheless treats `wanted_start is not None` as proof that a wanted range exists; it can report “yes” based only on those held sessions. Base this flag on whether the wanted range was actually constructed, or report caught-up as n/a until its end is known.
